english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 This offence is no longer eligible for a Penalty Notice for Disorder as they may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

(i) Section 149(5) of the Licensing Act 2003 provides exceptions to this offence where:
(a) the relevant person is aged 18 or over,
(b) the individual is aged 16 or 17,
(b) the alcohol is beer, wine or cider,
(c) its purchase or supply is for consumption is at a table meal on relevant premises, and (d) the individual is accompanied at the meal by an individual aged 18 or over.
(ii) Fingerprints, photographs and DNA samples may be taken from an individual where he/she is subject to arrest and the Penalty Notice is issued at a police station.
(iii) This is a specified offence under the Schedule to the National Police Records (Recordable Offences) Regulations 2000 to be a PNC Recordable Offence. Therefore offenders must be fingerprinted and photographed as well as PNC recordable.
